_meta.description: Printer intelligence database: firmware quirks, material compatibility, calibration guidance, and known failure modes. Keyed by the same printer_id as safety_profiles.json.
_meta._split_note: Safety-floor profile for AI-controlled FDM printing.  Engineering depth (each printer's quirks, its calibration recipes, and the failures it is known for) is available in Kiln Pro; see https://kiln3d.com/pricing.
_meta.has_chamber_sensor_note: has_chamber_sensor: whether the machine has a chamber temperature sensor whose reading its firmware reports. true/false only where a primary source settles it; null means unknown, never false, and every row must answer. Bambu rows come from Bambu Studio's own per-printer configuration (resources/printers/<model_id>.json): a chamber temperature is shown only where support_chamber_temp_display, or failing that support_chamber, is true. The Elegoo Centauri Carbon row comes from Elegoo's own wiki, which carries a chamber-thermistor replacement procedure for it (B0C2N1). Read by adapters whose protocol publishes a chamber field for every model regardless of hardware.
_meta.nozzle_clumping_probe_note: nozzle_clumping_probe: where this machine taps the bed to feel for a blob on the nozzle, as its maker publishes it -- detection_area_mm is [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in bed coordinates, and defeated_by lists the slicing modes that skip the probe. A part placed in that area stops the detection working, so the rectangle is a physical fact about the machine like build_volume_mm, not a judgement. Present only for models whose maker states it; absent means Kiln does not know, never that the machine has no probe.
_meta.motion_note: motion: the physical facts that decide whether Kiln may move the head on an idle machine that may still hold a part -- which part moves in Z (z_carrier, xy_layout), how Z finds its datum and where (z_home_method, z_home_xy_mm), whether the vendor's own homing routine travels sideways before Z is known (home_routine_travels_blind), the firmware family and what it does with an unhomed move (unhomed_move_policy: refused / clamped / unclamped), the commanded Z ceiling and what kind of source states it (z_travel_limit_mm, z_travel_limit_kind), the vendor's park verb and position (park_verb, park_position_mm, park_refuses_unhomed), and any vendor-stated purge or wipe station (purge_wipe_station; 'served_plan' on the Bambu rows whose station rides with the plan document Kiln Pro serves for that printer, never as public coordinates). Every field has a _sources entry {class, note}; class is the gate's real input: vendor_config / vendor_sentence / vendor_layout / vendor_slicer / firmware_docs settle a fact, community / not_found do not -- and a field on an unsettled class is null in this file, with the hearsay in the note. 'Descends onto the plate' is derived, never stored: false only for endstop_switch_off_plate, endstop_switch_top and nozzle_contact_strip. z_carrier may be inferred from a vendor layout name only under the rule in kiln.motion_facts.Z_CARRIER_FROM_LAYOUT, marked class vendor_layout so the plan text can say so. The note carries no link: the URL or file:line each fact was read from is research provenance and lives in Kiln Pro's motion provenance overlay, as every other research provenance does. Vocabulary, loader and derivations: kiln.motion_facts. Read 2026-09-16 from vendor firmware configs, vendor wikis and manuals, the vendors' own slicer profiles, and three vendor firmware images (Ender-3 V4, SPARKX i7, Neptune 4); the per-row refs say which.

z_home_xy_mm.note: `G1 X{0-sensors.probes[0].offsets[0]} Y{10-sensors.probes[0].offsets[1]} F18000` then line 57 `G30`: the probe lands at X0 Y10 in the centre-origin frame, 10 mm rearward of plate centre. home_routine_travels_blind.note: homey.g `G1 H2 Z10 F18000 ; Lift the Z axis by 10 mm` is a relative hop that runs even with Z unhomed (RRF G1 H2 ignores endstops and homing) and precedes every X/U/Y motion, so false. The clearance is only 10 mm (20 mm during X/U homing) below wherever the bed sat: the bed is the Z carrier, so the lift is a 10 mm bed drop, and the Y pass then crosses the whole plate.

park_refuses_unhomed.note: The vendor dialect has no park verb, so there is no unhomed behaviour to state.

purge_wipe_station.note: The station is a G150.x firmware macro with no published coordinates.
